title: agentOS — Virtual operating system for agents
excerpt: A virtual operating system for agents, with execution, filesystem, orchestration, and apps in one lightweight library.
content_html:
Give agents an operating system as a library.

Each agent gets a lightweight OS for execution, filesystems, orchestration, and apps. Runs in your existing backend – no sandboxes, VMs, or SaaS.

Bring any agent or framework.

Pi, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode on the same virtual operating system—with native Rivet orchestration and integrations for Eve and Flue.

Tiny runtime.
Battle-tested security.

Powered byWebAssemblyandV8 isolates.

The same technology poweringChromeandCloudflare Workers.

Linux-compatiblewith POSIX files, processes, and networking.

Execution

Run Bash, Node.js, Python, and registry software inside the same isolated VM.

  • Native JavaScript performance

    Run Node.js on native V8 isolates with the full JIT, not JavaScript compiled to WASM.

  • Built-in type checks

    Type-check agent-generated code and return diagnostics so the agent can fix errors.

  • Bindings

    Expose typed backend functions without giving credentials to the VM.

  • Subprocesses

    Spawn, stream, signal, and manage child processes with Linux-like semantics.

  • Network requests & servers

    Make outbound requests or serve HTTP from inside the VM under explicit permissions.

Explore execution docs

agentOS VM Execution

The agent writes one program instead of a chain of tool calls.

Node.js runtime docs

Filesystem

Every agent gets its own persistent POSIX filesystem. Mount S3, Google Drive, host directories, or a full sandbox at a normal path, then use familiar files and shell tools everywhere.

Explore the filesystem

Orchestration

Schedule recurring agent jobs, build durable RivetKit workflows, connect agents, and share live sessions with ordinary application code.

Preview

Apps

Deploy AI-generated applications for each of your users. Every server runs in agentOS, and the entire deployment stack is a library in your existing backend—not extra infrastructure.

  • REST APIs & frontends

    Serve APIs and generated interfaces from the same application.

  • SQLite

    Store durable application data in an actor-owned SQLite database.

  • Workflows & queues

    Run durable jobs that can sleep, retry, resume, and process queued work.

  • Crons & schedules

    Schedule recurring application work while idle instances sleep.

  • Multiplayer

    Share realtime state between every user connected to an application.

Explore agentOS Apps

Whatever the workload, there's a package for it.

Extend agentOS with agents, filesystems, browsers, and software from one registry.

Built for flexible, production-grade agents.

Persist agent state, expose backend functions, review tool calls, route models, and attach a full sandbox only when a workload needs one.

Ships wherever your backend ships.

Each VM is a Rivet Actor with durable state. Your existing deployment works.

Library

npm install and run in your process. No servers.

Get Started

Rivet Cloud

Managed agentOS on Rivet's edge network with BYOC support. Scales to millions of agents.

Sign Up

Self-Host

Run the open-source platform on Kubernetes, VMs, or bare metal.

Self-Hosting Docs

Turn your backend into the agent platform.

Open source under Apache 2.0. One npm install away.

content_html_zh:
为代理提供一个操作系统作为库。

每个代理都有一个用于执行、文件系统、编排和应用程序的轻量级操作系统。 在您现有的后端中运行 – 无沙箱、虚拟机或 SaaS。

带上任何代理或框架。

Pi、Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 位于同一虚拟操作系统上 - 具有针对 Eve 和 Flue 的本机 Rivet 编排和集成。

微小的运行时间。经过实战考验的安全性。

由 WebAssembly 和 V8 隔离提供支持。

Chrome 和 Cloudflare Workers 使用相同的技术。

Linux 与 POSIX 文件、进程和网络兼容。

执行

在同一个隔离的虚拟机内运行 Bash、Node.js、Python 和注册表软件。

  • 原生 JavaScript 性能在原生 V8 上运行 Node.js，使用完整的 JIT，而不是编译为 WASM 的 JavaScript。
  • 内置类型检查对代理生成的代码进行类型检查并返回诊断信息，以便代理可以修复错误。
  • 绑定公开类型化的后端函数，而不向虚拟机提供凭据。
  • 子进程使用类似 Linux 的语义生成、流式传输、发出信号并管理子进程。
  • 网络请求和服务器在明确的权限下从虚拟机内部发出出站请求或提供 HTTP 服务。

Explore the filesystem

编排

安排重复的代理作业、构建持久的 RivetKit 工作流程、连接代理并与普通应用程序代码共享实时会话。

预览

Apps

为每个用户部署人工智能生成的应用程序。 每台服务器都在agentOS中运行，整个部署堆栈是现有后端中的一个库，而不是额外的基础设施。

  • REST API 和前端从同一应用程序提供 API 和生成的接口。
  • SQLite将持久应用程序数据存储在参与者拥有的 SQLite 数据库中。
  • 工作流和队列运行可休眠、重试、恢复和处理排队工作的持久作业。
  • Crons 和时间表在空闲实例休眠时安排重复的应用程序工作。
  • 多人游戏在连接到应用程序的每个用户之间共享实时状态。
